title: Dizzy playing the North Park in the sixties
summary: He corrects Kimery's chronology: Dizzy first played for him at the North Park in the sixties.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: Wow, wow. So I was thinking now with... Because Dizzy - we’re talking about Dizzy - your first encounter with Dizzy as the Jazz Showcase, was that late forties or in the fifties?
No. The Showcase was - When I was at the North Park, that was in the sixties.
Sixties, ok. I got my chronology off there.
He came in and played and I think Roy Haynes came and played with him, Bunky Green, and Jay Peters, a saxophonist from here, who had played with Hampton.
